label: Latitude
description: Latitude of the site (used for Coriolis force and albedo calculation)

label: Air pressure
description: Long-term average air pressure at the site

label: Seiche parameter
description: Fraction of wind energy transferred to seiche (internal wave) energy

label: Seiche parameter (winter)
description: Fraction of wind energy transferred to seiche energy in winter (used instead of a_seiche when N2 < strat_sumr, only if SplitSeicheParameter = true)

label: Stratification threshold
description: Brunt-Vaisala frequency threshold below which a_seiche_w is used instead of a_seiche (only used if SplitSeicheParameter = true)

label: Seiche energy distribution
description: Fit parameter controlling the vertical distribution of seiche energy

label: Initial seiche energy
description: Initial total seiche energy

label: Filtered wind fit
description: Fit parameter for the (optionally pre-filtered) wind speed used to allot seiche energy

label: Wind drag coefficient
description: Wind drag coefficient at 10 m: a near-constant physical value (~0.001) if WindDragModel = 1, or itself a calibration parameter (~1) if WindDragModel = 2 or 3

label: Bottom drag coefficient
description: Bottom drag coefficient used in the momentum equations when BottomFriction is enabled

label: Geothermal heat flux
description: Geothermal heat flux applied at the lake bed

label: Short-wave scaling
description: Scaling (fit) parameter applied to incoming short-wave radiation over open water

label: Long-wave scaling
description: Scaling (fit) parameter applied to incoming long-wave radiation from the sky

label: Turbulent heat flux scaling
description: Scaling (fit) parameter applied to the convective (sensible) and latent heat fluxes

label: Light absorption scaling
description: Scaling (fit) parameter applied to the light absorption (extinction) coefficient

label: Surface absorption fraction
description: Fraction of incoming short-wave radiation absorbed as heat directly at the water surface (the remainder penetrates and is absorbed with depth per the light-extinction file)

label: Water albedo
description: User-defined albedo of open water (only used if UserDefinedWaterAlbedo = true; otherwise computed internally from Grishchenko tables)

label: Ice short-wave scaling
description: Scaling (fit) parameter for incoming short-wave radiation in the presence of ice/snow-ice/snow (only used if IceModel is on)

label: Freezing temperature
description: Freezing temperature of water

label: Snow threshold temperature
description: Threshold air temperature distinguishing accumulation from melting of snow on ice-covered lakes

label: Initial snow thickness
description: Initial snow thickness (only used if SnowModel is on)

label: Initial white ice thickness
description: Initial white (snow) ice thickness (only used if IceModel is on)

label: Initial black ice thickness
description: Initial black (clear) ice thickness (only used if IceModel is on)
